objective: Determine whether a small predeclared set of no-lookahead multi-day market states consistently favors continuation or reversal for the unchanged fixed-five signal population across all four development half-years.

population.warmup: exclude signals without 1,920 prior/current completed M15 market bars; no imputation

information_time: signal M15 close, before next-bar entry

features.volatility_ratio_5d_20d: sqrt(mean(M15 return^2, last 480)) / sqrt(mean(M15 return^2, last 1920))

reporting: pooled fixed-five state x half-year metrics
strategy x state x half-year metrics
side x state x half-year metrics
support, default/severe net and PF for both actions
action advantage, positive/negative months, ex-best-two dates and positive-date concentration
four-fold sign consistency and strategy breadth
selection_rule: This stage is descriptive. A passing state only authorizes a separate finite prospective family preregistration; it does not become a candidate automatically.
stop_rule: If no individual predeclared state bin passes every gate, close RQ-020B and do not construct an interaction, optimized threshold or router from these results.
prohibited: no threshold optimization or tree/model search
no interactions between state dimensions in this stage
no strategy parameter, side, exit or weight changes
no Family I, Family J or F05 local repair
